user.title: Connect iCloud
user.description: Sign in with your Apple ID and an app-specific password (create one at appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords). Two-factor authentication must be enabled on the Apple ID.

data_description.apple_id: Your iCloud login, e.g. name@icloud.com, name@me.com or name@mac.com.
data_description.app_password: Format xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx. Never use your regular Apple ID password here.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate iCloud
reauth_confirm.description: iCloud rejected the stored app-specific password for {apple_id}. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach iCloud. Check the internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Apple rejected the credentials. Check the Apple ID and the app-specific password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already configured.

init.title: iCloud MCP options
init.description: Choose which tool groups the MCP server exposes and which write actions are allowed.

data.allow_delete: Allow deleting events, contacts, e-mails and notes
